title: CulturalBench: A Robust, Diverse, and Challenging Cultural Benchmark by Human-AI CulturalTeaming

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models' cultural knowledge using a benchmark of 1,696 human-verified questions (in both multiple-choice and binary true/false formats) spanning 17 diverse topics like daily life, social etiquette, and celebrations across 45 global regions.

Comparing the accuracy of language models on cultural questions grouped by geographic regions and sub-continents (e.g., comparing performance on questions about North America and South Asia versus underrepresented regions like Africa and South America) to identify representational disparities.
